scope: Exact-provision resolution architecture for Irish property questions; it does not create a property-specific legal conclusion.
verified_points: Land Registration Rules 2012 commenced on 1 February 2013.
Rule 159 governs inspection/copy access to filed documents and contains specified entitlement routes.
Rule 160 provides official-search mechanisms for names, specified property and register/map entries.
The 2013 Rules amended the 2012 Rules and commenced on 1 November 2013.
The 2021 Rules further amended the 2012 Rules and commenced on 16 December 2021.
core_rule: REGIME → EXACT PROVISION → VERSION → COMMENCEMENT/TRANSITION → PROPOSITION → LEGAL EFFECT
